items.sentence: The small rabbit ate half of the sweet orange carrot.
Her main concern was the small bird in the rain.
Today, firefighters will rescue the kitten from the tall oak tree.
Today, the food critic tasted every soup at the village fair.
Today, the charity sent warm blankets to the cold mountain village.
When someone offered cake, the storybook giant's rage melted.
Today, the mouse could afford one small cheese with its coins.
Nearby towns unite their workers and tools to clean the river.
Today, the kind farmer raised an orphan lamb with warm milk.
Today, camels can bear the long hot walk across sand.
